facts.version_note: Frozen API exposes updated_at, not a numeric version.
facts.value: The initializer values populate `MatToQuat`'s local `nxt` lookup. After the function chooses `i` as the position of the largest normalized matrix diagonal, it reads `nxt[i]` to obtain `j` and then `nxt[j]` to obtain `k`; those three indices direct the fallback formula's reads from the normalized 3×3 matrix and writes into the quaternion's vector components.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/quatlib:.sdata2
facts.version_note: Frozen API exposes updated_at, not a numeric version.
facts.value: Constants from the pool are read by quatlib's scalar rotation calculations. Matrix conversion and Euler extraction use zero, unit, half-scale, and singularity thresholds; axis-angle conversion uses a minimum-length guard, normalization and half-angle factors; Euler conversion uses half angles; and quaternion interpolation uses unit weights, epsilon guards, doubling factors, and π/2. These values control numerical branches and scale trigonometric or quaternion-component calculations, while the read-only pool itself is not modified.
facts.reason: Source literals and local array initializer are visible, but no compiled object/map proves section ownership or emitted pool layout.
